name: English
h1: Your company video, built with AI, delivered in 7 days.
lead: Our teams combine motion design and artificial intelligence: script, voice-over, music and animation, in 25+ languages. Agency-grade results in one week, from €390.
prompt: Create a 48-second launch video for NOXEM GROUP's windows & doors range: doors, windows, sliding doors, shutters, every colour, French voice-over, upbeat tone.
consent: Video produced for NOXEM GROUP and published with the agreement of NOXEM GROUP.
ai_h2: A complete production pipeline, accelerated by AI
c1p: Your message, your selling points, your tone. Written to grab attention from the first second.
c3p: Original music and sound effects timed to every animation.
c4p: Landscape for LinkedIn and YouTube, vertical for TikTok and Reels, square for ads.
lg_h2: One video, every language your customers speak
lg_sub: Our teams adapt the same video into each language: native voice-over, translated on-screen text. Ideal for export, international trade shows and subsidiaries.
lg_note: Your language isn't listed? Just ask.
w_sub: Manufacturing, construction, real estate, food, software: pace, colours and tone adapt to your brand.
w_note: "Demo" videos are showcases made with fictional brands. NOXEM GROUP videos are published with the agreement of NOXEM GROUP.
p2d: 30–45 s for an offer, a product or an event.
p3d: 45–60 s, voice-over, music and sound design.
p4d: 4 short videos a month, all year round.
p_note: Included: 2 revision rounds. Vertical format or another language: +€90. 50% deposit on order.

s1p: 15 minutes to define your message and audience.
s2p: Our teams write the script and storyboard. You approve.
s3p: Animation, voice, music and sound design, assisted by AI.
s4p: Your video ready to publish, in every format you need.
